en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
yo: Olúwa ni olùṣọ́ èmi àgùntàn rẹ̀, èmi kì yóò ṣe aláìní.

en: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
yo: Ọlọ́run ni ààbò àti agbára wa ó jẹ́ olùrànlọ́wọ́ ní ìgbà ìpọ́njú.

en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
yo: Ẹni tí ó gbé ibi ìkọ̀kọ̀ Ọ̀gá-ògo ni yóò sinmi ní ibi òjìji Olódùmarè.

en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, From whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the Lord, Which made heaven and earth.
yo: Èmi yóò gbé ojú mi sórí òkè wọ̀n-ọn-nì— níbo ni ìrànlọ́wọ́ mi yóò ti wá? Ìrànlọ́wọ́ mi tí ọwọ́ Olúwa wá, ẹni tí ó dá ọ̀run òun ayé.

en: This is the day which the Lord hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
yo: Èyí ni ọjọ́ tí Olúwa dá: ẹ jẹ́ kí ayọ̀ kí inú wa sì máa dùn nínú rẹ̀.

en: (ג) Commit thy way unto the Lord; Trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
yo: Fi ọ̀nà rẹ lé Olúwa lọ́wọ́; gbẹ́kẹ̀lé pẹ̀lú, òun yóò sì ṣe é.

en: (ט) O taste and see that the Lord is good: Blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
yo: Tọ́ ọ wò kí o sì rí i wí pé Olúwa dára; ẹni ayọ̀ ni ọkùnrin náà tí ó gbẹ́kẹ̀lé ààbò nínú rẹ̀.

en: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
yo: Olúwa ni ìmọ́lẹ̀ mi àti ìgbàlà mi; ta ni èmi yóò bẹ̀rù? Olúwa ni ibi ìsádi ẹ̀mí mi, ẹ̀rù ta ni yóò bà mí?

en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
yo: Ẹ lọ sí ẹnu-ọ̀nà rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọpẹ́ àti sí àgbàlá rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìyìn; ẹ fi ọpẹ́ àti ìyìn fún orúkọ rẹ̀.

en: (נ) Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.
yo: Ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ ni fìtílà sí ẹsẹ̀ mi àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí ipa ọ̀nà mi.

en: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: He shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
yo: Gbé ẹrù rẹ lọ sí ọ̀dọ̀ Olúwa yóò sì mú ọ dúró; òun kò ní jẹ́ kí olódodo ṣubú.

en: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
yo: Yin Olúwa, ìwọ ọkàn mi, kí o má ṣe gbàgbé gbogbo oore rẹ̀,

en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; At thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
yo: Ìwọ ti fi ipa ọ̀nà ìyè hàn mí; Ìwọ yóò kún mi pẹ̀lú ayọ̀ ní iwájú rẹ, pẹ̀lú ìdùnnú ayérayé ní ọwọ́ ọ̀tún rẹ.

en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
yo: Nítorí pé ìbínú rẹ̀ wà fún ìgbà díẹ̀, ojúrere rẹ̀ wà títí ayérayé; ẹkún lè pẹ́ títí di alẹ́, ṣùgbọ́n ayọ̀ yóò wá ní òwúrọ̀.

en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: From him cometh my salvation.
yo: Nínú Ọlọ́run nìkan ni ọkàn mi ti rí ìsinmi; ìgbàlà mi ti ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀ wá.

en: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: The Lord will give grace and glory: No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
yo: Nítorí Olúwa Ọlọ́run jẹ́ òòrùn àti asà; Olúwa fún ni ní ojúrere àti ọlá; kò sí ohun rere kan tí yóò fàsẹ́yìn fún àwọn tí ó rìn ní àìlábùkù.

en: So teach us to number our days, That we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
yo: Kọ́ wa bí a ti ń kaye ọjọ́ wa dáradára, kí àwa ba à lè fi ọkàn wa sípa ọgbọ́n.

en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Marvellous are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
yo: Èmi yóò yìn ọ, nítorí tẹ̀rù tẹ̀rù àti tìyanu tìyanu ní a dá mi; ìyanu ní iṣẹ́ rẹ; èyí nì ni ọkàn mi sì mọ̀ dájúdájú.

en: (ק) The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
yo: Olúwa wà ní tòsí gbogbo àwọn tí ń ké pè é, sí gbogbo ẹni tí ń ké pè é ní òtítọ́.

en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.
yo: Dá ọkàn mímọ́ sí inú mi, Ọlọ́run, kí o sì tún ẹ̀mí dídúró ṣinṣin ṣe sínú mi.

en: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; And lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he shall direct thy paths.
yo: Gbẹ́kẹ̀lé Olúwa pẹ̀lú gbogbo ọkàn rẹ má ṣe sinmi lé òye ara à rẹ. Mọ̀ ọ́n ní gbogbo ọ̀nà rẹ òun yóò sì máa tọ́ ipa ọ̀nà rẹ.

en: Honour the Lord with thy substance, And with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
yo: Fi ọrọ̀ rẹ bọ̀wọ̀ fún Olúwa, pẹ̀lú àkọ́so oko rẹ,

en: Commit thy works unto the Lord, And thy thoughts shall be established.
yo: Fi ohun gbogbo tí o bá ṣe lé Olúwa lọ́wọ́, èrò rẹ yóò sì ṣe é ṣe.

en: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
yo: Orúkọ Olúwa, ilé ìṣọ́ agbára ni; olódodo sá wọ inú rẹ̀, ó sì rí ìgbàlà.

en: Train up a child in the way he should go: And when he is old, he will not depart from it.
yo: Tọ́ ọmọdé ní ọ̀nà tí yóò tọ̀: nígbà tí ó bá dàgbà, kì yóò kúrò nínú rẹ̀.

en: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
yo: Ju gbogbo nǹkan tókù lọ, pa ọkàn rẹ mọ́, nítorí òun ni orísun ìyè.

en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: But grievous words stir up anger.
yo: Ìdáhùn pẹ̀lẹ́ yí ìbínú padà ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀rọ̀ líle máa ń ru ìbínú sókè.

en: The liberal soul shall be made fat: And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
yo: Ẹni tí ń ṣoore yóò máa gbèrú sí i; ẹni tí ó tu ẹlòmíràn lára yóò ní ìtura.

en: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, And he addeth no sorrow with it.
yo: Ìbùkún Olúwa ń mú ọrọ̀ wá, kì í sì í fi ìdààmú sí i.

en: Righteousness exalteth a nation: But sin is a reproach to any people.
yo: Òdodo a máa gbé orílẹ̀-èdè lékè, ṣùgbọ́n ìtìjú ni ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ jẹ́ fún àwùjọ káwùjọ.

en: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; They shall mount up with wings as eagles; They shall run, and not be weary; And they shall walk, and not faint.
yo: ṣùgbọ́n àwọn tí ó gbẹ́kẹ̀lé Olúwa yóò sọ agbára wọn di ọ̀tun. Wọn yóò fìyẹ́ fò lókè bí idì; wọn yóò sáré àárẹ̀ kò ní mú wọn, wọn yóò rìn òòyì kò ní kọ́ wọn.

en: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: Be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; Yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
yo: Nítorí náà má bẹ̀rù, nítorí èmi wà pẹ̀lú rẹ; má ṣe jẹ́ kí àyà kí ó fò ọ́, nítorí èmi ni Ọlọ́run rẹ. Èmi yóò fún ọ lókun èmi ó sì ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́. Èmi ó gbé ọ ró pẹ̀lú ọwọ́ ọ̀tún òdodo mi.

en: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; And through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: When thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burnt; Neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
yo: Nígbà tí ìwọ bá ń la omi kọjá, Èmi yóò wà pẹ̀lú rẹ; àti nígbà tí ìwọ bá ń la odò kọjá wọn kì yóò bò ọ́ mọ́lẹ̀. Nígbà tí ìwọ bá la iná kọjá, kò ní jó ọ; ahọ́n iná kò ní jó ọ lára.

en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, Whose mind is stayed on thee: Because he trusteth in thee.
yo: Ìwọ yóò pa á mọ́ ní àlàáfíà pípé ọkàn ẹni tí ó dúró ṣinṣin, nítorí ó gbẹ́kẹ̀lé ọ.

en: And a highway shall be there, and a way, And it shall be called The way of holiness; The unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: The wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
yo: Àti òpópónà kan yóò wà níbẹ̀: a ó sì máa pè é ní ọ̀nà ìwà mímọ́. Àwọn aláìmọ́ kì yóò tọ ọ̀nà náà; yóò sì wà fún àwọn tí ń rìn ní ọ̀nà náà, àwọn ìkà búburú kì yóò gba ibẹ̀ kọjá.

en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, And their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.
yo: kò sí ohun ìjà tí a ṣe sí ọ tí yóò lè ṣe nǹkan, àti gbogbo ahọ́n tí ó dìde sí ọ ní ìdájọ́ ni ìwọ ó dá ní ẹ̀bi. Èyí ni ogún àwọn ìránṣẹ́ Olúwa, èyí sì ni ìdáláre wọn láti ọ̀dọ̀ mi,” ni Olúwa wí.

en: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, And the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.
yo: “Dìde, tànmọ́lẹ̀, nítorí ìmọ́lẹ̀ rẹ ti dé, ògo Olúwa sì ràdàbò ọ́.

en: But he was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities: The chastisement of our peace was upon him; And with his stripes we are healed.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n a sá a lọ́gbẹ́ nítorí àìṣedéédéé wa a pa á lára nítorí àìṣòdodo wa; ìjìyà tí ó mú àlàáfíà wá fún wa wà lórí i rẹ̀, àti nípa ọgbẹ́ rẹ̀ ni a fi mú wa láradá.

en: Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, Call ye upon him while he is near:
yo: Ẹ wá Olúwa nígbà tí ẹ lè rí i; ẹ pè é nígbà tí ó wà nítòsí.

en: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, And satisfy thy soul in drought, And make fat thy bones: And thou shalt be like a watered garden, And like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
yo: Olúwa yóò máa tọ́ ọ yín nígbà gbogbo; òun yóò tẹ́ gbogbo àìní yín lọ́rùn ní ilẹ̀ tí oòrùn ń tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ yóò sì fún egungun rẹ lókun. Ìwọ yóò sì dàbí ọgbà tí a bomirin dáradára, àti bí orísun tí omi rẹ̀ kì í gbẹ.

en: For I know the thoughts that I think towards you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
yo: Nítorí mo mọ èrò tí mo rò sí yín,” ni Olúwa wí, “àní èrò àlàáfíà, kì í sì ṣe fún ibi, èrò láti fún un yín ní ìgbà ìkẹyìn àti ìrètí ọjọ́ iwájú.

en: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
yo: ‘Pè mí, èmi ó sì dá ọ lóhùn, èmi ó sì sọ ohun alágbára ńlá àti ọ̀pọ̀ ohun tí kò ṣe é wádìí tí ìwọ kò mọ̀ fún ọ.’

en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.
yo: “Ṣùgbọ́n ìbùkún ni fún ọkùnrin náà tí ó gbẹ́kẹ̀lé Olúwa, tí ó sì fi Olúwa ṣe ìgbẹ́kẹ̀lé rẹ̀.

en: It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
yo: Nítorí ìfẹ́ Olúwa tí ó lágbára ni àwa kò fi ṣègbé, nítorí ti àánú rẹ kì í kùnà. Wọ́n jẹ́ ọ̀tún ní àárọ̀; títóbi ni òdodo rẹ̀.

en: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
yo: Èmi kò ha ti pàṣẹ fún ọ bí? Jẹ́ alágbára kí o sì mú àyà le. Má ṣe bẹ̀rù, má sì ṣe rẹ̀wẹ̀sì, nítorí pé Olúwa à rẹ yóò wà pẹ̀lú rẹ ní ibikíbi tí ìwọ bá ń lọ.”

en: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
yo: Jẹ́ alágbára kí o sì ní ìgboyà. Má ṣe bẹ̀rù tàbí jáyà nítorí i wọn, nítorí Olúwa Ọlọ́run rẹ ń lọ pẹ̀lú rẹ, Òun kò ní fi ọ́ sílẹ̀ tàbí kọ̀ ọ́ sílẹ̀.”

en: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
yo: Olúwa yóò jà fún un yín; kí ẹ̀yin kí ó sá à mu sùúrù.”

en: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
yo: “ ‘ “Kí Olúwa bùkún un yín, kí ó sì pa yín mọ́. Kí Olúwa kí o mú ojú rẹ̀ kí ó mọ́lẹ̀ sí i yín lára. Kí ó sì ṣàánú fún un yín. Kí Olúwa bojú wò yín, kí ó sì fún un yín ní àlàáfíà.” ’

en: There is none holy as the Lord: For there is none beside thee: Neither is there any rock like our God.
yo: “Kò sí ẹni tí ó mọ́ bi Olúwa; kò sí ẹlòmíràn bí kò ṣe ìwọ; kò sì sí àpáta bi Ọlọ́run wa.

en: if my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
yo: tí àwọn ènìyàn, tí a fi orúkọ mi pè, tí wọ́n bá rẹ ara wọn sílẹ̀, tí wọ́n sì gbàdúrà, tí wọ́n sì rí ojú mi, tí wọ́n sì yí kúrò nínú ọ̀nà búburú wọn, nígbà náà, èmi yóò gbọ́ láti ọ̀run, èmi yóò sì dárí ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ wọn jì wọ́n èmi yóò sì wo ilẹ̀ wọn sàn.

en: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.
yo: Nehemiah wí pé, “Ẹ lọ kí ẹ gbádùn oúnjẹ tí ẹ yàn láàyò kí ẹ sì mú ohun dídùn, kí ẹ sì mú díẹ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn tí kò ní. Ọjọ́ yìí, mímọ́ ni fún Olúwa wa. Ẹ má ṣe banújẹ́, nítorí ayọ̀ Olúwa ni agbára yín.”

en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.
yo: “Fa ara rẹ súnmọ́ Ọlọ́run, ìwọ ó sì rí àlàáfíà; nípa èyí ni rere yóò wá bá ọ.

en: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; And what doth the Lord require of thee, But to do justly, and to love mercy, And to walk humbly with thy God?
yo: Ó ti fihàn ọ́, ìwọ ènìyàn, ohun tí ó dára, àti ohun tí Olúwa ń béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ? Bí kò ṣe láti ṣe òtítọ́, kí o sì fẹ́ràn àánú, àti kí o rìn ní ìrẹ̀lẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Ọlọ́run rẹ̀.

en: The Lord God is my strength, And he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, And he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
yo: Olúwa Olódùmarè ni agbára mi, òun yóò sí ṣe ẹsẹ̀ mi bí ẹsẹ̀ abo àgbọ̀nrín, yóò sí mú mi rìn lórí ibi gíga. Sí olórí akọrin lórí ohun èlò orin olókùn mi.

en: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; He will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; He will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
yo: Olúwa Ọlọ́run rẹ wà pẹ̀lú rẹ, Ó ní agbára láti gbà ọ là. Yóò yọ̀ ni orí rẹ fún ayọ̀; Yóò tún ọ ṣe nínú ìfẹ́ rẹ̀, Yóò sì fi orin yọ̀ ní orí rẹ.”

en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, That there may be meat in mine house, And prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, If I will not open you the windows of heaven, And pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
yo: Ẹ mú gbogbo ìdámẹ́wàá wá sí ilé ìṣúra, kí oúnjẹ bá à lè wà ní ilé mi, ẹ fi èyí dán mi wò,” ní Olúwa àwọn ọmọ-ogun wí, “kí ẹ sì wò bí èmi kò bá ní sí àwọn fèrèsé ọ̀run fún yin, kí èmi sì tú ìbùkún àkúnwọ́sílẹ̀ jáde fún yín, tó bẹ́ẹ̀ tí kì yóò sì ààyè láti gbà á.

en: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, Saith the Lord of hosts.
yo: Ó sì dáhùn ó sì wí fún mi pé, “Èyí ni ọ̀rọ̀ Olúwa sí Serubbabeli tó wí pé: ‘Kì í ṣe nípa ipá, kì í ṣe nípa agbára, bí kò ṣe nípa Ẹ̀mí mi,’ ni Olúwa àwọn ọmọ-ogun wí.

en: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hid.
yo: “Ẹyin ni ìmọ́lẹ̀ ayé. Ìlú tí a tẹ̀dó sórí òkè kò lè fi ara sin.

en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n, ẹ kọ́kọ́ wá ìjọba Ọlọ́run ná àti òdodo rẹ̀, yóò sì fi gbogbo àwọn nǹkan wọ̀nyí kún un fún yín pẹ̀lú.

en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
yo: “Béèrè, a ó sì fi fún yín; wá kiri, ẹ̀yin yóò sì rí; kànkùn, a ó sì ṣí i sílẹ̀ fún yín.

en: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
yo: “Ẹ wá sọ́dọ̀ mi gbogbo ẹ̀yin tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ tí a sì di ẹrù wíwúwo lé lórí, èmi yóò sì fún yín ní ìsinmi.

en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
yo: Nítorí níbi ti ènìyàn méjì tàbí mẹ́ta bá kó ara jọ ni orúkọ mi, èmi yóò wà láàrín wọn níbẹ̀.”

en: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
yo: Ẹ kọ́ wọn láti máa kíyèsi ohun gbogbo èyí tí mo ti pàṣẹ fún yín. Nítorí èmi wà pẹ̀lú yín ní ìgbà gbogbo títí tí ó fi dé òpin ayé.”

en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
yo: Alábùkún fún ni àwọn ọlọ́kàn mímọ́, nítorí wọn yóò rí Ọlọ́run.

en: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n nígbà tí ìwọ bá ń gbàdúrà, wọ inú iyàrá rẹ lọ, sé ìlẹ̀kùn mọ́ ara rẹ, gbàdúrà sí Baba rẹ ẹni tí ìwọ kò rí. Nígbà náà ni Baba rẹ tí ó mọ gbogbo ohun ìkọ̀kọ̀ rẹ, yóò san án fún ọ.

en: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
yo: Bí ẹ̀yin bá gbàgbọ́, ẹ̀yin lè rí ohunkóhun tí ẹ bá béèrè nínú àdúrà gbà.”

en: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is unpossible; but with God all things are possible.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n Jesu wò wọ́n, ó sì wí fún wọn pé, “Ènìyàn ni èyí ṣòro fún; ṣùgbọ́n fún Ọlọ́run ohun gbogbo ni ṣíṣe.”

en: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
yo: “Jesu sì wí fún un pé, ‘Bí ìwọ bá le gbàgbọ́: ohun gbogbo ni ó ṣe é ṣe fún ẹni tí ó bá gbàgbọ́.’ ”

en: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
yo: Torí náà, mo wí fún yín ohunkóhun tí ẹ bá béèrè fún nínú àdúrà, ẹ ní ìgbàgbọ́ pé, ó tí tẹ̀ yín lọ́wọ́, yóò sì jẹ́ tiyín.

en: For with God nothing shall be unpossible.
yo: Nítorí kò sí ohun tí Ọlọ́run kò le ṣe.”

en: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
yo: Ẹ fi fún ni, a ó sì fi fún yín; òsùwọ̀n dáradára, àkìmọ́lẹ̀, àti àmìpọ̀, àkúnwọ́sílẹ̀, ni a ó wọ́n si àyà yín: nítorí òsùwọ̀n náà tí ẹ̀yin fi wọ́n, òun ni a ó padà fi wọ́n fún yín.”

en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
yo: Ó sì pa òwe kan fún wọn láti fi yé wọn pe, ó yẹ kí a máa gbàdúrà nígbà gbogbo, kí a má sì ṣàárẹ̀.

en: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
yo: Kíyèsi i, èmí fún yín ní àṣẹ láti tẹ ejò àti àkéekèe mọ́lẹ̀, àti lórí gbogbo agbára ọ̀tá, kò sì ṣí ohun kan bí ó ti wù tí ó ṣe, tí yóò pa yín lára.

en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
yo: “Nítorí Ọlọ́run fẹ́ aráyé tó bẹ́ẹ̀ gẹ́ẹ́, tí ó fi ọmọ rẹ̀ kan ṣoṣo fún ni, kí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó bá gbà á gbọ́, má bà á ṣègbé, ṣùgbọ́n kí ó lè ní ìyè àìnípẹ̀kun.

en: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
yo: Jesu dá wọn lóhùn pé, “Èmi ni ọ̀nà, òtítọ́ àti ìyè, kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó lè wá sọ́dọ̀ Baba, bí kò ṣe nípasẹ̀ mi.

en: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
yo: Àlàáfíà ni mo fi sílẹ̀ fún yín pé, àlàáfíà mi ni mo fi fún yin, kì í ṣe bí ayé ti fi fún ni. Ẹ má ṣe jẹ́ kí ọkàn yín dàrú, ẹ má sì jẹ́ kí ó wárìrì.

en: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
yo: “Èmi ni àjàrà, ẹ̀yin ni ẹ̀ka. Ẹni tí ó ń gbé inú mi, àti èmi nínú rẹ̀, òun ni yóò so èso lọ́pọ̀lọ́pọ̀, nítorí ní yíya ara yín kúrò lọ́dọ̀ mi, ẹ kò lè ṣe ohun kan.

en: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
yo: Jesu sì tún sọ fún wọn pé, “Èmi ni ìmọ́lẹ̀ ayé, ẹni tí ó bá tọ̀ mí lẹ́yìn kì yóò rìn nínú òkùnkùn, ṣùgbọ́n yóò ní ìmọ́lẹ̀ ìyè.”

en: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
yo: Olè kì í wá bí kò ṣe láti jalè, láti pa, àti láti parun; èmi wá kí wọn lè ní ìyè, àní kí wọn lè ní i lọ́pọ̀lọ́pọ̀.

en: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
yo: Jesu wí fún un pé, “Èmi ni àjíǹde àti ìyè, ẹni tí ó bá gbà mí gbọ́, bí ó tilẹ̀ kú, yóò yè.

en: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
yo: “Nǹkan wọ̀nyí ni mo ti sọ fún yín tẹ́lẹ̀, kí ẹ̀yin kí ó lè ní àlàáfíà nínú mi. Nínú ayé, ẹ̀yin ó ní ìpọ́njú; ṣùgbọ́n ẹ tújúká; mo ti ṣẹ́gun ayé.”

en: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n iye àwọn tí ó gbà á, àní àwọn náà tí ó gbà orúkọ rẹ̀ gbọ́, àwọn ni ó fi ẹ̀tọ́ fún láti di ọmọ Ọlọ́run.

en: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀yin yóò gba agbára, nígbà tí Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́ bá bà lé e yín; ẹ̀yin yóò sì máa ṣe ẹlẹ́rìí mi ni Jerusalẹmu, àti ní gbogbo Judea, àti ní Samaria, àti títí dé òpin ilẹ̀ ayé.”

en: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
yo: Peteru sì wí fún wọn pé, “Ẹ ronúpìwàdà, kí a sì bamitiisi olúkúlùkù yín ní orúkọ Jesu Kristi fún ìdáríjì ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ yín. Ẹ̀yin yóò sì gba ẹ̀bùn Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́.

en: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
yo: Wọ́n sì wí fún un pé, “Gbá Jesu Kristi Olúwa gbọ́, a ó sì gbà ọ́ là, ìwọ àti àwọn ará ilé rẹ pẹ̀lú.”

en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
yo: Àwa sì mọ̀ pé ohun gbogbo ni ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ pọ̀ sí rere fún àwọn tí ó fẹ́ Ọlọ́run, àní fún àwọn ẹni tí a pè gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìpinnu rẹ̀.

en: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
yo: Kí ni àwa yóò wí nísinsin yìí sí nǹkan ìyanu wọ̀nyí? Bí Ọlọ́run bá wà pẹ̀lú wa, ta ni yóò kọjú ìjà sí wa?

en: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n nínú gbogbo nǹkan wọ̀nyí, àwa ju ẹni tí ó ṣẹ́gun lọ nípasẹ̀ Kristi ẹni tí ó fẹ́ wa.

en: that if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
yo: Bí ìwọ bá fi ẹnu rẹ̀ jẹ́wọ́ “Jesu ní Olúwa,” tí ìwọ si gbàgbọ́ ní ọkàn rẹ pé, Ọlọ́run jí i dìde kúrò nínú òku, a ó gbà ọ́ là.

en: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
yo: Kí ẹ má sì da ara yín pọ̀ mọ́ ayé yìí; ṣùgbọ́n kí ẹ paradà láti di tuntun ní èrò inú yín, kí ẹ̀yin kí ó lè rí ìdí ìfẹ́ Ọlọ́run, tí ó dára, tí ó sì ṣe ìtẹ́wọ́gbà, ti ó sì pé.

en: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
yo: Ẹ máa yọ̀ ni ìrètí; ẹ máa mú sùúrù nínú ìpọ́njú; ẹ máa dúró gbọingbọin nínú àdúrà.

en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
yo: Ǹjẹ́ kí Ọlọ́run ìrètí kí ó fi gbogbo ayọ̀ òun àlàáfíà kún yín bí ẹ̀yin ti gbà á gbọ́, kí ẹ̀yin kí ó lè pọ̀ ní ìrètí nípa agbára Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́.

en: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n Ọlọ́run fi ìfẹ́ òun pàápàá sí wa hàn nínú èyí pé, nígbà tí àwa jẹ́ ẹlẹ́ṣẹ̀, Kristi kú fún wa.

en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
yo: Kò sí ìdánwò kan tí ó ti bá yín, bí kò ṣe irú èyí tí ó mọ níwọ̀n fún ènìyàn, ṣùgbọ́n olódodo ni Ọlọ́run, ẹni ti kì yóò jẹ́ kí á dán an yín wò ju bí ẹ̀yin ti le gbà, ṣùgbọ́n tí yóò sì ṣe ọ̀nà àbáyọ pẹ̀lú nínú ìdánwò náà, kí ẹ̀yin ba à lè faradà á.

en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
yo: Ìfẹ́ a máa mú sùúrù, ìfẹ́ a máa ṣeun, ìfẹ́ kì í ṣe ìlara, ìfẹ́ kì í fẹ̀, ìfẹ́ kì í sọ̀rọ̀ ìgbéraga.

en: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as you know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
yo: Nítorí náà ẹ̀yin ará mi olùfẹ́ ẹ máa dúró ṣinṣin, láìyẹsẹ̀, kí ẹ máa pọ̀ si í ní iṣẹ́ Olúwa nígbà gbogbo, ní ìwọ̀n bí ẹ̀yin ti mọ̀ pé iṣẹ́ yin kì í ṣe asán nínú Olúwa.

en: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are past away; behold, all things are become new.
yo: Nítorí náà bí ẹnìkan bá wà nínú Kristi, ó di ẹ̀dá tuntun: ohun àtijọ́ ti kọjá lọ; kíyèsi i, ohun tuntun ti dé.

en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
yo: Kí olúkúlùkù ènìyàn ṣe gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti pinnu ní ọkàn rẹ̀; kì í ṣe àfi ìkùnsínú ṣe, tàbí ti àìgbọdọ̀ má ṣe; nítorí Ọlọ́run fẹ́ onínúdídùn ọlọ́rẹ.

en: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
yo: Òun sì wí fún mi pé, “Oore-ọ̀fẹ́ mi tó fún ọ, nítorí pé a sọ agbára mi di pípé nínú àìlera.” Nítorí náà tayọ̀tayọ̀ ni èmi ó kúkú máa fi ṣògo nínú àìlera mi, kí agbára Kristi lè máa gbé inú mi.

en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n èso ti Ẹ̀mí ni ìfẹ́, ayọ̀, àlàáfíà, ìpamọ́ra, ìwà pẹ̀lẹ́, ìṣoore, ìgbàgbọ́, ìwà tútù, àti ìkóra-ẹni níjanu, òfin kan kò lòdì sí irú wọ̀nyí,

en: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
yo: Ẹ má sì jẹ́ kí àárẹ̀ ọkàn mú wa ní ṣíṣe rere, nítorí tí a ó kórè nígbà tí àkókò bá dé, bí a kò bá ṣe àárẹ̀.

en: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
yo: Nítorí oore-ọ̀fẹ́ ní a fi gbà yín là nípa ìgbàgbọ́. Èyí kì í ṣe nípa agbára ẹ̀yin fúnra yín: ẹ̀bùn Ọlọ́run ni,

en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
yo: Ǹjẹ́ ẹni tí o lè ṣe lọ́pọ̀lọ́pọ̀ ju gbogbo èyí tí a ń béèrè tàbí tí a ń rò lọ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí agbára tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ nínú wa.

en: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
yo: Ní àkótán, ara mí, ẹ jẹ́ alágbára nínú Olúwa, àti nínú agbára ipá rẹ̀.

en: and be ye kind one to another, tender hearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
yo: Ẹ máa ṣoore fún ọmọnìkejì yín, ẹ ní ìyọ́nú, ẹ máa dáríjì ara yín, gẹ́gẹ́ bí Ọlọ́run nínú Kristi ti dáríjì yín.

en: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
yo: Ẹ má ṣe ṣe àníyàn ohunkóhun; ṣùgbọ́n nínú ohun gbogbo, nípa àdúrà àti ẹ̀bẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìdúpẹ́, ẹ máa fi ìbéèrè yín hàn fún Ọlọ́run.

en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
yo: Èmi le ṣe ohun gbogbo nínú Kristi ẹni ti ń fi agbára fún mi.

en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n Ọlọ́run mi yóò pèsè ní kíkún fún gbogbo àìní yín, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ nínú ògo nínú Kristi Jesu.

en: being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
yo: Ohun kan yìí sá à dá mi lójú pé, ẹni tí ó ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ iṣẹ́ rere nínú yín, yóò ṣe àṣepé rẹ̀ títí di ọjọ́ náà tí Jesu Kristi yóò dé.

en: and whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
yo: Ohunkóhun tí ẹ̀yin bá ń ṣe, ẹ máa fi tọkàntọkàn ṣe é fún Olúwa, kí í ṣe fún ènìyàn;

en: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
yo: Ẹ máa yọ̀ nígbà gbogbo. Ẹ máa gbàdúrà nígbà gbogbo. Ẹ máa dúpẹ́ nígbà gbogbo nínú ipòkípò tí o wù kí ẹ wà; nítorí pé, èyí ni ìfẹ́ Ọlọ́run fún yin nínú Kristi Jesu nítòótọ́.

en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
yo: Nítorí pé Ọlọ́run kò fún wa ni ẹ̀mí ìbẹ̀rù, bí kò ṣe ti agbára, àti ti ìfẹ́, àti ti ìsẹ́ra-ẹni ti ó yè kooro.

en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
yo: Gbogbo ìwé mímọ́ ni ó ní ìmísí Ọlọ́run tí ó sì ní èrè fún ẹ̀kọ́, fún ìbániwí, fún ìtọ́ni, fún ìkọ́ni tí ó wà nínú òdodo.

en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
yo: Ǹjẹ́ ìgbàgbọ́ ní ìdánilójú ohun tí o ń retí, ìjẹ́rìí ohun tí a kò rí.

en: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
yo: Kí ọkàn yín má ṣe fà sí ìfẹ́ owó, ki ohun tí ẹ ní tó yin; nítorí òun tìkára rẹ̀ ti wí pé, “Èmi kò jẹ́ fi ọ́ sílẹ̀, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni èmi kò jẹ́ kọ̀ ọ́ sílẹ̀.”

en: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
yo: Ẹ máa lépa àlàáfíà pẹ̀lú ènìyàn gbogbo, àti ìwà mímọ́, láìsí èyí yìí kò sí ẹni tí yóò rí Olúwa.

en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
yo: Nítorí náà, ẹ jẹ́ kí a wá si ibi ìtẹ́ oore-ọ̀fẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìgboyà, kí a lè rí àánú gbà, kí a sì rí oore-ọ̀fẹ́ láti máa ran ni lọ́wọ́ ní àkókò tí ó wọ̀.

en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
yo: Bí ó bá ku ọgbọ́n fún ẹnikẹ́ni, kí ó béèrè lọ́wọ́ Ọlọ́run ẹni tí fi fún gbogbo ènìyàn ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀, tí kì í sì ka àlébù sí; a ó sì fi fún un.

en: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
yo: Nítorí náà, ẹ tẹríba fún Ọlọ́run. Ẹ kọ ojú ìjà sí èṣù, òun ó sì sá kúrò lọ́dọ̀ yín.

en: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
yo: Ẹ jẹ́wọ́ ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ yín fún ara yín, kí ẹ sì máa gbàdúrà fún ara yín, kí a lè mú yín láradá. Iṣẹ́ tí àdúrà olódodo ń ṣe ní agbára púpọ̀.

en: casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
yo: Ẹ máa kó gbogbo àníyàn yín lé e; nítorí tí òun ń ṣe ìtọ́jú yín.

en: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
yo: Ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀yin ni ìran tí a yàn olú àlùfáà, Orílẹ̀-èdè mímọ́, ènìyàn ọ̀tọ̀ ki ẹ̀yin lè fi ọláńlá ẹni tí ó pè yín jáde kúrò nínú òkùnkùn sínú ìmọ́lẹ̀ ìyanu rẹ̀ hàn.

en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
yo: Olúwa kò fi ìlérí rẹ̀ jáfara, bí àwọn ẹlòmíràn ti ka ìjáfara sí; ṣùgbọ́n ó ń mú sùúrù fún yín nítorí kò fẹ́ kí ẹnikẹ́ni ṣègbé, bí kò ṣe kí gbogbo ènìyàn wá sí ìrònúpìwàdà.

en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
yo: Bí àwa bá jẹ́wọ́ ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ wa, olóòtítọ́ àti olódodo ni òun láti dárí ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ wa jì wá, àti láti wẹ̀ wá nù kúrò nínú àìṣòdodo gbogbo.

en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
yo: Ìbẹ̀rù kò sí nínú ìfẹ́; ṣùgbọ́n ìfẹ́ tí ó pé ń lé ìbẹ̀rù jáde; nítorí tí ìbẹ̀rù ni ìyà nínú. Ẹni tí ó bẹ̀rù kò pé nínú ìfẹ́.

en: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
yo: Èyí sì ni ìgboyà tí àwa ní níwájú rẹ̀, pé bí àwa bá béèrè ohunkóhun gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìfẹ́ rẹ̀, ó ń gbọ́ tí wa.

en: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
yo: Kíyèsi i, èmi dúró ni ẹnu ìlẹ̀kùn, èmi sì ń kànkùn, bí ẹnikẹ́ni bá gbọ́ ohun mi, tí ó sì ṣí ìlẹ̀kùn, èmi yóò sì wọlé tọ̀ ọ́ wá, èmi yóò sì máa bá a jẹun, àti òun pẹ̀lú mi.

en: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
yo: Ọlọ́run yóò sì nu omijé gbogbo nù kúrò ni ojú wọn; kì yóò sì ṣí ikú mọ́, tàbí ọ̀fọ̀, tàbí ẹkún, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kí yóò sí ìrora mọ́, nítorí pé ohun àtijọ́ tí kọjá lọ.”

en: And behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
yo: “Kíyèsi i, èmi ń bọ̀ kánkán; èrè mí sì ń bẹ pẹ̀lú mi, láti sán fún olúkúlùkù gẹ́gẹ́ bí iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ yóò tí rí.
